description: This source file contains functions for upgrading and managing firmware for Linksys devices, including handling partition selection, image verification, and device-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on environment variables and UBI settings.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Checks whether the provided image file matches the device's factory signature.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the standard firmware upgrade procedure for Linksys devices, handling different magic numbers and partition setup.

methods.name: linksys_get_cmdline_rootfs_device
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem device from kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: linksys_get_current_boot_part_emmc
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition on eMMC devices based on UBI environment variables or root device detection.

methods.name: linksys_set_target_partitions_emmc
methods.description: Sets the target boot and root partitions for eMMC based on the current boot partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys_emmc
methods.description: Handles the eMMC-specific firmware upgrade process for Linksys devices.
